tools.name: inspect_ssl
tools.description: Connects securely via TLS socket to inspect an endpoint's SSL/TLS certificate chain. Returns certificate validity, exact expiration date, remaining valid days, issuer organization, subject common name, SHA-256 fingerprint, and serial number.

tools.name: query_dns
tools.description: Performs live DNS resolution queries using Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH 1.1.1.1). Resolves standard DNS Resource Record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA) and returns authoritative answers, TTL values, and resolution latency.

tools.name: inspect_dns
tools.description: Alias for query_dns. Resolves live DNS records via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1) to diagnose domain propagation, mail exchange routing, or ownership verification records.

tools.name: ping_endpoint
tools.description: Pings a public HTTP or HTTPS web service or API endpoint to measure Time-To-First-Byte (TTFB) latency, HTTP response status code, status message, and inspect diagnostic HTTP headers (Cloudflare ray, server, cache-control, HSTS).

tools.name: get_tech_pulse
tools.description: Fetches real-time developer ecosystem intelligence: latest stable releases of major infrastructure software and developer tools (Kubernetes, Docker, Bun, Next.js, Go, Rust), alongside trending developer repositories on GitHub.
